# Data absent
- `rna_tissue_detail_gtex.tsv`: Tissue-specific transcript expression levels from RNA-seq. Data obtained from GTEx and is based on The Human Protein Atlas version 25.1 and Ensembl version 109. Accessed from https://www.proteinatlas.org/humanproteome/tissue/data#gtex_tissue_groups_rna and downloaded using https://www.proteinatlas.org/download/tsv/rna_tissue_detail_gtex.tsv.zip on 5 September, 2025.
- `sa_location_Secreted.tsv`: Secreted proteins and where they are secreted to. Accessed and downloaded on 5 September, 2025, using https://www.proteinatlas.org/search/sa_location%3ASecreted+-+unknown+location%2CSecreted+in+brain%2CSecreted+in+female+reproductive+system%2CSecreted+in+male+reproductive+system%2CSecreted+in+other+tissues%2CSecreted+to+blood%2CSecreted+to+digestive+system%2CSecreted+to+extracellular+matrix%2CImmunoglobulin+genes with 'Secretome location' checked (to display that column in the downloaded output).
- `tissue_category_rna_any_Tissue.tsv`: Tissue-specific proteins and their level of specificity. Accessed and downloaded on 5 September, 2025, using https://www.proteinatlas.org/search/tissue_category_rna%3Aany%3BTissue+enriched%2CGroup+enriched%2C+Tissue+enhanced+AND+sort_by%3Atissue+specific+score with 'RNA tissue specificity', 'RNA tissue distribution', 'RNA tissue specificity score' checked.
- `tissue_specificity_with_tissue_id.csv`: Tissue-specific proteins and the tissues in which they are specific. Output from `~/ch5_integration/5.3 knowledge_graph_building/identify_tissue_for_tissue_specific_rna.py`.
